batch.title: WOCAT mechanism rule — spot-check (24 Oct 2026)
batch.notes: Random sample of the 'no mechanism, no unit' verdicts (25 drops, 15 keeps) so we can state an error rate. Approve = the verdict (drop or keep) was right; Reject = it was wrong. This export is read by hand — it is NOT run through the normal apply step, so approving a drop will not restore the unit. Bare ratings (no comment at all) were dropped by rule and are not sampled. Rebuilt 9 Nov 2026: findings already removed are left out.

units.quote: - water_quantity: value +2 — comment: With each rain, each micro basin can collect up to 1.200l of water. Each hectare collects an average of 360.000 liter of rain, runoff included. Collected in the micro basin, the water has enough time to infiltrate in the soil profile and eventually in the water table. Local people assert that after the implementation of the Technology, the water level in the wells has raised.
